description: This file defines asynchronous flow functions for managing 'tags' in a backend API, including creating, updating, deleting, retrieving, and listing tags, with logging for each operation.

methods.name: tags_repo.TagRow create_tag_flow(session: AsyncSession, *, name: str)
methods.description: Creates a new tag asynchronously, logs the operation, and returns the created tag object.

methods.name: tags_repo.TagRow update_tag_flow(session: AsyncSession, *, tag_id: UUID, name: str)
methods.description: Updates an existing tag asynchronously, logs the operation, and returns the updated tag object.

methods.name: None delete_tag_flow(session: AsyncSession, *, tag_id: UUID)
methods.description: Deletes a tag asynchronously and logs the operation.

methods.name: tags_repo.TagRow get_tag_flow(session: AsyncSession, *, tag_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves a tag by ID asynchronously, logs the operation, and returns the tag object.

methods.name: tuple[list[tags_repo.TagRow],int] list_tags_flow(session: AsyncSession, *, q: str | None, limit: int, offset: int)
methods.description: Lists tags with optional search query, limit, and offset; logs the operation; returns a list of tags and total count.
